payload.author: claude
payload.body: Scope correction: the MCP server (frick-mcp) is done + in review. The agent-kit half of this title was NOT ported to Rust — packages/agent-kit was DELETED in the cutover (FR-255) because only the TS CLI consumed it. If an agent-kit equivalent is wanted for the Rust toolchain it needs a fresh ticket; otherwise this story is really just the MCP server.
